beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Tokyo makes translation infrastructural across permission, venue, moving image, language, textile exchange, recognition and retained seasons. This chapter follows memory: The venue disappears, schedules change and links decay; preservation choices determine which technical history remains citable and contestable.
beats.onScreen: Then: The official collection archive exposes seasons back to 2006 and maintains brand and season indexes.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The official collection archive exposes seasons back to 2006 and maintains brand and season indexes. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Museum interpretation, organizer archives and stream platforms preserve different kinds of fashion memory under different rights.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No single public archive joins every invitation, technical credit, show file, rights record, textile provenance, stream and correction history.
